```{r}

if (!requireNamespace("renv", quietly = TRUE)) {
```

# Parameters
```{r}
# Station columns expected in the dataset
STATIONS <- c("ACTogether.HQ", "Makerere", "MengoSS", "RC.ClimateCentre", "RC.Warehouse")

# Hydrodynamic scenario thresholds and durations
THRESHOLDS <- c(20, 40, 60, 80, 100)  # mm totals
DURATIONS  <- c(1L, 3L, 6L)           # hours

# Dry gap for event counting, per duration
DRY_GAP_H  <- c(`1` = 3L, `3` = 6L, `6` = 12L)

# Minimum number of reporting stations required to compute a network summary
MIN_STATIONS <- 3L

# Timestamp time zone, sums are TZ invariant, this sets display and parsing
TZ <- "Africa/Kampala"
```

# Helper functions
```{r}
roll_sum_complete <- function(x, k) {
  # Sliding sum that returns NA if any NA is inside the window
  slider::slide_dbl(x, ~ if (any(is.na(.x))) NA_real_ else sum(.x),
                    .before = k - 1, .complete = TRUE)
}

prepare_hourly <- function(raw_df, stations, ts_col = "ts_raw", tz = "UTC") {
  # If requested ts_col is not present, fall back to first column
  if (!ts_col %in% names(raw_df)) ts_col <- names(raw_df)[1]

  stations_present <- intersect(stations, names(raw_df))
  if (!length(stations_present)) stop("None of the expected station columns found, check STATIONS or name normalisation.")

  df <- raw_df %>%
    mutate(ts = as.POSIXct(.data[[ts_col]], tz = tz)) %>%
    arrange(ts) %>%
    select(ts, all_of(stations_present)) %>%
    mutate(across(all_of(stations_present), \(z) suppressWarnings(as.numeric(z))))

  full_index <- tibble(ts = seq.POSIXt(min(df$ts, na.rm = TRUE),
                                       max(df$ts, na.rm = TRUE), by = "hour"))

  long <- df %>%
    pivot_longer(-ts, names_to = "station", values_to = "mm") %>%
    group_by(station) %>%
    right_join(full_index, by = "ts") %>%
    arrange(ts, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
    ungroup()

  gaps <- long %>% group_by(station) %>% summarise(missing_hours = sum(is.na(mm)), .groups = "drop")
  message("Missing hours per station:\n", paste(capture.output(print(gaps)), collapse = "\n"))

  long
}

compute_rolling <- function(long_df) {
  long_df %>%
    group_by(station) %>%
    arrange(ts, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
    mutate(
      mm_1h = mm,
      mm_3h = roll_sum_complete(mm, 3),
      mm_6h = roll_sum_complete(mm, 6)
    ) %>%
    ungroup()
}

summarise_network <- function(roll_df, min_stations = 1L) {
  roll_df %>%
    select(ts, station, mm_1h, mm_3h, mm_6h) %>%
    pivot_longer(starts_with("mm_"), names_to = "dur_lab", values_to = "mm_total") %>%
    mutate(duration = as.integer(str_extract(dur_lab, "\\d+"))) %>%
    group_by(ts, duration) %>%
    summarise(
      n_stn   = sum(!is.na(mm_total)),
      max_any = ifelse(n_stn >= min_stations, max(mm_total, na.rm = TRUE), NA_real_),
      med_stn = ifelse(n_stn >= min_stations, median(mm_total, na.rm = TRUE), NA_real_),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
}

count_windows_vec <- function(series, thresholds) {
  tibble(threshold = thresholds,
         n_windows = map_int(thresholds, function(th) sum(series >= th, na.rm = TRUE)))
}

count_events_with_cooldown <- function(series, thr, cooldown_hours) {
  # Conservative event counter, after an exceedance skip 'cooldown_hours' samples
  x <- series >= thr
  i <- 1L
  n <- length(x)
  events <- 0L
  while (i <= n) {
    if (isTRUE(x[i])) {
      events <- events + 1L
      i <- i + cooldown_hours
    } else {
      i <- i + 1L
    }
  }
  events
}

count_events_vec <- function(series, duration, thresholds, dry_gap_map) {
  cooldown <- unname(dry_gap_map[as.character(duration)])
  tibble(threshold = thresholds,
         n_events = map_int(thresholds, function(th) count_events_with_cooldown(series, th, cooldown)))
}
```

# Load data
```{r}
# Load data
hourly_rain <- read.csv(
  here("Data", "raw", "Rainfall_estimation", "Hourly_kamp", "data", "shear_rain.csv"),
  check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# --- Normalise column names so they match STATIONS ---
names(hourly_rain) <- names(hourly_rain) |>
  gsub("-", ".", x = _, fixed = TRUE) |>
  gsub("\\s+", ".", x = _, perl = TRUE)

# Make the first column a clean timestamp name used below
names(hourly_rain)[1] <- "ts_raw"

hourly <- prepare_hourly(hourly_rain, STATIONS, ts_col = "ts_raw", tz = TZ)

# Sanity checks
message("Stations found: ", paste(intersect(STATIONS, names(hourly_rain)), collapse = ", "))
```

# Rolling totals per station
```{r}
by_station <- compute_rolling(hourly)

kable(head(by_station, 10), caption = "Sample of station-level rolling totals")
```

# Network summaries per timestamp
```{r}
net <- summarise_network(by_station, min_stations = MIN_STATIONS)

# Coverage and annualisation factor
t0 <- min(net$ts, na.rm = TRUE)
t1 <- max(net$ts, na.rm = TRUE)
years_covered <- as.numeric(difftime(t1, t0, units = "days")) / 365.25
message(glue("Time span: {format(t0, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%M')} to {format(t1, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%M')} , ~{round(years_covered, 2)} years"))

kable(head(net, 10), caption = "Network summaries, any-station max and station-median")
``` 

# Frequency of overlapping windows
```{r}
# Per-station window counts
by_station_long <- by_station %>%
  select(ts, station, mm_1h, mm_3h, mm_6h) %>%
  pivot_longer(starts_with("mm_"), names_to = "dur_lab", values_to = "mm_total") %>%
  mutate(duration = as.integer(str_extract(dur_lab, "\\d+")))

per_station_windows <- by_station_long %>%
  group_by(station, duration) %>%
  summarise(data = list(mm_total), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(res = map(data, ~ count_windows_vec(.x, THRESHOLDS))) %>%
  select(-data) %>%
  unnest(res) %>%
  mutate(per_year = n_windows / years_covered)

# Any-station max window counts
windows_any <- map_dfr(DURATIONS, function(d) {
  vec <- net$max_any[net$duration == d]
  tibble(duration = d) %>%
    bind_cols(count_windows_vec(vec, THRESHOLDS))
}) %>%
  mutate(summary = "any_station", per_year = n_windows / years_covered)

# Median-station window counts
windows_median <- map_dfr(DURATIONS, function(d) {
  vec <- net$med_stn[net$duration == d]
  tibble(duration = d) %>%
    bind_cols(count_windows_vec(vec, THRESHOLDS))
}) %>%
  mutate(summary = "median_station", per_year = n_windows / years_covered)

network_window_counts <- bind_rows(windows_any, windows_median)

kable(network_window_counts %>% arrange(summary, duration, threshold),
      caption = "Counts of overlapping windows meeting thresholds")
```

# Frequency of distinct events with dry gap
```{r}
# Any-station event counts
events_any <- map_dfr(DURATIONS, function(d) {
  vec <- net$max_any[net$duration == d]
  tibble(duration = d) %>%
    bind_cols(count_events_vec(vec, d, THRESHOLDS, DRY_GAP_H))
}) %>%
  mutate(summary = "any_station", per_year = n_events / years_covered)

# Median-station event counts
events_median <- map_dfr(DURATIONS, function(d) {
  vec <- net$med_stn[net$duration == d]
  tibble(duration = d) %>%
    bind_cols(count_events_vec(vec, d, THRESHOLDS, DRY_GAP_H))
}) %>%
  mutate(summary = "median_station", per_year = n_events / years_covered)

network_event_counts <- bind_rows(events_any, events_median)

kable(network_event_counts %>% arrange(summary, duration, threshold),
      caption = "Counts of distinct events, dry-gap method")
```

# Scenario aligned tables, 15 combinations
```{r}
scenario_grid <- tidyr::expand_grid(duration = DURATIONS, threshold = THRESHOLDS) %>%
  arrange(duration, threshold)

scenario_windows_any <- scenario_grid %>%
  left_join(windows_any %>% select(duration, threshold, n_windows, per_year),
            by = c("duration", "threshold"))

scenario_events_any <- scenario_grid %>%
  left_join(events_any %>% select(duration, threshold, n_events, per_year),
            by = c("duration", "threshold"))

kable(scenario_windows_any, caption = "Window counts, any-station max, aligned to flood scenarios")
kable(scenario_events_any,  caption = "Event counts, any-station max, aligned to flood scenarios")

# Plot scenario_windows_any as a table using ggpubr::ggtexttable
library(ggpubr)

# Prepare a nicely formatted table for plotting
table_plot <- ggtexttable(
  scenario_events_any,
  rows = NULL,
  theme = ttheme("light")
)

print(table_plot)

```

# Diagnostics plots
```{r}
# Time series of network maximum rolling totals
net %>%
  filter(!is.na(max_any)) %>%
  mutate(duration = factor(duration)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(ts, max_any)) +
  geom_line() +
  facet_wrap(~ duration, ncol = 1, scales = "free_y", labeller = labeller(duration = label_both)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = seq(0, 100, by = 20), linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 100), breaks = seq(0, 100, by = 20)) +
  labs(title = "Network maximum rolling totals", x = "Time", y = "mm over duration") +
  theme_bw()

# Heatmap, window counts any-station
ggplot(windows_any, aes(factor(threshold), factor(duration), fill = n_windows)) +
  geom_tile() +
  geom_text(aes(label = n_windows), color = "white") +
  scale_fill_viridis_c() +
  labs(title = "Window counts, any station", x = "Threshold , mm", y = "Duration , h") +
  theme_bw()

# Heatmap, event counts any-station
ggplot(events_any, aes(factor(threshold), factor(duration), fill = n_events)) +
  geom_tile() +
  geom_text(aes(label = n_events), color = "white") +
  scale_fill_viridis_c() +
  labs(title = "Event counts, any station", x = "Threshold , mm", y = "Duration , h") +
  theme_bw()
```
